name: check_room
description: Checks whether a room can be booked for a requested time slot. It only checks and answers Available or Unavailable; it does not save, change or create any booking. All times are whole minutes since midnight, from 0 to 1440, so 10:00 is 600 and 24:00 is 1440. The slot must start after the current time, be at most 120 minutes long, avoid a blocked room, and not overlap existing bookings (touching is allowed).

start.description: Requested start time, in whole minutes since midnight (10:00 = 600).

end.description: Requested end time, in whole minutes since midnight (24:00 = 1440).

now.description: The current time, in whole minutes since midnight.

blocked.description: True if the room is blocked (for example for maintenance), false otherwise.

bookings.description: Existing bookings for the room. May be empty.

start.description: Booking start, in whole minutes since midnight.

end.description: Booking end, in whole minutes since midnight.
